explanation: Fires only at the D1 step, and only when the agent has been choosing a1 and the previous trial reached S1 and was rewarded. It is 0 at every GO and D2 step, 0 while the agent is choosing a2, and 0 after a trial that reached S2 (rare) or was unrewarded, apart from about 2-6 on an unrewarded D1 right after a rewarded S1 streak. Its size grows with time in the episode: about 2-3 before trial 30, 5-7 around trials 40-80, and 8-10 in trials 89-99, where it fades by about 1 per trial over a long reward streak.
